chapter: Drum sets and New Orleans drummers
title: His first drum set, bass drum and foot pedal
summary: Hall describes his first outfit with snare, one cymbal, cowbell and wood block, rope-tension bass drums, gut snares and the early wooden pedal.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: What kind of a drum set did you have when you started out? Your very first drum set? Or what you played on Tubby's set I guess when you started.

Yeah, the first one he gave me, that time I had a wooden drum. I had a snare drum, pretty good size, I forget how big it was. And all kind of a make up set, you know. One cymbal and one cowbell. And at that days they wasn't used a hi-hat cymbal then. The cymbal was on the side of the drum, yeah, see. Worked with the foot pedal. That's right, together, yeah. And a pair of sticks, that's all. Nothing there. Did you have any wood blocks? Yeah, any wood block. But I mean, as anything else, nothing else. Nothing at all. Just two drums, pair of sticks, and a cowbell and a wood block.
How big was your bass drum?
Oh, in them days it was, well the one, I used a 24. They looked like around 20 to 29, big case of them, yeah. Most of them were 28.
One time they had one where you'd tighten those ropes.
Oh yeah, you'd pull those sticks.
Yeah, you'd pull them, yeah, wet them, you know.

Pull them with that, that's right. And we had gut sneds on them there. See, we didn't have wire sneds like that. I had an old time set on there. What was your first foot pedal like? It was, the pedal was made out of wood, like a hinge, you know.

And then the rod go straight up, and the spring was on top of it. See, you hook it. Oh yeah. Yeah, and the ball was in the middle, and you hit it that way. See, the spring pull it on top. See, the rod go straight up through that head. I forget what pedal they called that. No, it wasn't like pedal they got nothing. It wasn't homemade though. Oh no, they buy them that way. Yeah, they buy them that way. They buy them that way. They were a rod go over your drum. Yeah. And then you hook it on the back, the thing that you screw your, like you tighten your drum with, you know, the thing you had and the clamps of that, and it had a strap, you know, and you swing that way. Oh yeah, different kinds of pedal, that's what you're using there.
Did they respond pretty quickly? Yeah, they were right.
They were fast. Sure, just as fast as the one they got now. Sure they were. Very good pedal. Very good pedal. Yeah, very good.
